newsitem.title: USA: First Data sets 2-for-1 stock split.
newsitem.headline: First Data sets 2-for-1 stock split.

text.p: First Data Corp said on Thursday its board of directors approved a two-for-one split of common stock.
The company said in a statement the split would be effected in the form of a stock dividend.
First Data is a provider of credit card and information processing services.
The Board of Directors has established a Nov 1, 1996 record date and a Nov 15, 1996 distribution date for the stock dividend.
Shareholders of record on the record date will receive a stock dividend of one share of common stock for each share owned. Share certificates will be mailed on November 15, 1996.
In addition, the board declared the next regular quarterly dividend of $0.02 per common share payable on Jan 15, 1997 to stockholders of record on Jan 2, 1997.
First Data has about 224 million common shares outstanding.
